mapper.insert: insert into goodscollection.review(scores, textContent, goodsId, userId,dateTime) VALUES (#{scores},#{textContent},#{goodsId},#{userId},#{dateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from goodscollection.thumbsup where reviewId=#{reviewId} and userId=#{userId}
mapper.select: select * from goodscollection.review where userId=#{userId} order by dateTime desc
select review.* from goodscollection.review inner join goodscollection.publish on review.goodsId=publish.goodsId where publish.userId=#{userId} order by dateTime desc
select * from goodscollection.review where goodsId=#{goodsId} order by dateTime desc
select * from goodscollection.review where goodsId=#{goodsId} order by praise desc
